ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. This site-based course is for EOL EdM and CAS students whose cohort began Sum 2007. The course begins Sep 19 and ends Dec 6. Class sessions will be held at the Oak Brook, Multi-University Center on the following four weekends: Sep 19 and 20, Oct 3 and 4, Nov 7 and 8, and Dec 5 and 6. The four Friday evening sessions will be held from 5:30 to 9:30 PM, and Saturday sessions will be held from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: OCE Tuition $441.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $41.00 per Bill Hour.
